title: Glowing telescope
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='30' fill='#3a2a66' opacity='0.35'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='38' r='22' fill='#5a3fa0' opacity='0.35'/>
  <!-- tripod -->
  <rect x='44' y='62' width='7' height='28' rx='2' fill='#8a5a2a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='62' width='3' height='28' rx='1' fill='#b07840'/>
  <rect x='56' y='62' width='7' height='28' rx='2' fill='#8a5a2a'/>
  <rect x='56' y='62' width='3' height='28' rx='1' fill='#b07840'/>
  <rect x='38' y='76' width='30' height='6' rx='3' fill='#7a4a20'/>
  <rect x='38' y='76' width='30' height='2' rx='1' fill='#a86a30'/>
  <!-- tube body -->
  <g transform='rotate(-35 52 45)'>
    <rect x='30' y='36' width='48' height='20' rx='9' fill='#2f6fb8'/>
    <rect x='30' y='36' width='48' height='7' rx='4' fill='#4f9ae0'/>
    <rect x='30' y='36' width='10' height='20' rx='5' fill='#4f9ae0'/>
    <!-- eyepiece -->
    <rect x='24' y='41' width='9' height='10' rx='3' fill='#8a5a2a'/>
    <rect x='24' y='41' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#b07840'/>
    <!-- front lens ring -->
    <rect x='74' y='34' width='8' height='24' rx='4' fill='#1f4f88'/>
    <rect x='74' y='34' width='8' height='9' rx='4' fill='#3f8ad0'/>
    <!-- glowing lens -->
    <ellipse cx='78' cy='46' rx='4' ry='10' fill='#ffe066'/>
    <ellipse cx='78' cy='46' rx='4' ry='10' fill='#fff8c0' opacity='0.7'/>
    <ellipse cx='77' cy='43' rx='2' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.9'/>
  </g>
  <!-- lens flare sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe066'>
    <polygon points='90,20 92,26 98,28 92,30 90,36 88,30 82,28 88,26'/>
    <polygon points='70,12 71,16 75,17 71,18 70,22 69,18 65,17 69,16' opacity='0.8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- base knob glow on tripod -->
  <circle cx='52' cy='66' r='4' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='66' r='2' fill='#fff6c0'/>
</svg>
